record.body:
## Interfaces

dashboard/backend/areas.py load_areas(target) returns AreaView (subject, title, scope, open_count, ideas of AreaIdea: subject, text, status, area, effort, phase) and reads only through records and store.py. server/schemas.py adds AreaIdea, AreaView and AreasResponse (a RootModel over a list, so the JSON is a bare list); GET /api/areas is served through Reader.areas() with the snapshot-token cache. composer:area joins records.SOFT_TYPES. openapi.json and api-types.ts are regenerated. Frontend: state/areas.svelte.ts (bindAreas), the Areas section on Home.svelte, the Area.svelte screen, the area route in router.ts (#/area/<subject>), areaHref() in detail.ts, a shadcn Collapsible.

## Assumptions

An idea's effort is shown as recorded (the merged-effort alias remap is not applied). composer:area is a soft type so foreign stores return an empty list.

## Invariants

The effort backlog (snapshot.py) is unchanged and keeps promote and dismiss. Existing endpoint fixtures are byte-identical; only areas-rich and areas-minimal are new. The composer schema is unchanged.

## Conflicts

none
